findings.title: zero at t=1 with restart at t=2: order is KNOWN (zero observed before restart)
findings.expected_after_fix: a state meaning 'zero observed before the restart', not ORDER_UNDETERMINED

findings.title: real 200 ms: zero-crossing bracket contains the restart instant but is NOT reported as undetermined order
findings.expected_after_fix: the crossing bracket that contains the restart time is reported as undetermined order

findings.title: constantly-positive Iq (never decaying) still gets a DECAY verdict
findings.expected_after_fix: a neutral verdict ('last pre-restart sample nonzero'), with any decay/trend claim measured separately

findings.title: analyzer classification is not callable/testable (inline in main())
findings.expected_after_fix: analyze exposes the shipped classification so tests exercise the real path

findings.title: already-positive Iq: first positive sample after restart is reported as a resume time
findings.expected_after_fix: resume time/latency is None for an already-positive channel; the observation is kept under a diagnostic name

findings.title: session transitions are reported as a name set with no times
findings.expected_after_fix: session transitions carry the time of each change

findings.title: a complete, consistent manifest still loads
regr_linear72_baseline status=ERROR (hashes intact) is accepted
findings.expected_after_fix: rejected: a regression RUN is a required trial too
findings.observed: rejected: required trials are not status OK (identity/completeness check, not a group count): [('regr_linear72_baseline', 'ERROR')]

findings.title: step_up_clean_cad72 with a single repeat hash vs repeats_per_case=2 is accepted
findings.expected_after_fix: rejected: repeat count must match the manifest's own contract
findings.observed: rejected: required trials record fewer repeat hashes than the run's own repeats_per_case contract (name, recorded, required): [('step_up_clean_cad72', 1, 2)]; a one-element hash list is trivially self-consistent and is not evidence of a repeated run

findings.title: regression entry whose new_csv_sha256 does not match its run is accepted
findings.expected_after_fix: rejected: the regression entry must be linked to its run's CSV hash
findings.observed: rejected: regression entries are not linked to their own runs: [('regr_floor_above_profile', 'entry new_csv_sha256=cccccccccccccccc... != run csv_sha256=a36b31282ba36e29...')]

findings.title: runner.check_required() and the ERROR regression run
findings.expected_after_fix: rejected by the runner too - and by NAME, not only because an OK-per-group count happened to drop below its quota
findings.observed: rejected (RequiredTrialMissing): required trials missing (group: expected, got): {'regression_ac_t2': (4, 3)}

findings.title: runner.check_required() accepts a single repeat hash against repeats_per_case=2
findings.expected_after_fix: rejected: the runner enforces the repeat-count contract as well
findings.observed: rejected (RequiredCaseFailed): required trials with fewer repeat hashes than repeats_per_case=2 (name, recorded): [('step_up_clean_cad72', 1)]
